query:
-- Inadimplência: total e por status
SELECT 'inadimplencia' as fonte,
  COALESCE(ca.status, 'pendente') as status_key,
  COUNT(*) as total,
  ROUND(SUM(CAST(ar.valorLiquido AS DECIMAL(18,2)) - CAST(COALESCE(ar.valorRecebidoLiquido, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2))), 2) as valor
FROM accounts_receivable ar
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT receivableId, status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receivableId ORDER BY id DESC) as rn
  FROM collection_actions
) ca ON ca.receivableId = ar.id AND ca.rn = 1
WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' 
AND ar.vencimentoData < CURDATE()
AND ar.tipo IN ('TITULO', 'RECEITA', 'ADIANTAMENTO')
AND (CAST(ar.valorLiquido AS DECIMAL(18,2)) - CAST(COALESCE(ar.valorRecebidoLiquido, 0) AS DECIMAL(18,2))) > 0
GROUP BY COALESCE(ca.status, 'pendente')
ORDER BY total DESC;
